summary: Candidate is a distinct micro-skill focused on parameter optimization (deriving optimal g) during training stage, complementary to peer candidates which focus on applying pre-computed or predefined weights during retrieval/ranking. No redundancy detected; peer candidates assume weights are already available, while this skill solves the upstream problem of learning g from training data using closed-form optimization. Single support reference validates the mathematical foundation (Equation 6.5-6.6). No conflicts detected.
